description: Writes general load combinations from plain factors, e.g. { name: "ULS1", factors: { "SW": 1.35, "SDL": 1.35, "LM1": 1.5 } } — for hand-picked combinations; for the full code set use ec_combinations_apply / cs454_combinations_apply. Each name is looked up: static load cases (ST), moving-load cases (MV) and existing combinations (CB) are recognised, and a combination made in the same call can be used in a later one; write "CS:<name>" for a construction-stage result, or a prefix when a name is in two places. type: add (default), envelope, abs, srss. Names ≤ 20 characters; a case listed twice is refused (CIVIL NX refuses the whole write). An existing name is refused unless replaceExisting: true. Previews unless apply: true with confirmPlanHash; civil_write_tables_undo reverses it.

factors.description: { "<case or combination>": factor } in order; envelope / srss members usually take 1.

replaceExisting.description: Overwrite combinations that already have these names. Only with the user's agreement.

name: civil_combinations_quick
title: Load combinations from factors
